newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fourth Australian dies using euthanasia law.
newsitem.headline: Fourth Australian dies using euthanasia law.

text.p: A 70-year-old Sydney woman has become the fourth Australian to commit suicide under the world's only voluntary euthanasia law in the remote Northern Territory, a euthanasia supporters group said on Tuesday.

The unidentified woman, who suffered from cancer, died in Darwin in the Northern Territory on the weekend using a machine which delivered a lethal injection, The National Coalition for Voluntary Euthanasia said on its Internet site "Deliverance".
The coalition said the woman was assisted by her doctor, Philip Nitschke, who has helped the previous three people die using the Northern Territory law.
The voluntary euthanasia law came into operation in the outback region in July last year. In September, 66-year-old cancer patient Bob Dent became the first person to use it.
The Australian parliament's lower house, the House of Representatives, has passed a bill aimed at overturning the euthanasia law and the upper house Senate is expected to vote on it this month.
Euthanasia is illegal in the rest of Australia, but doctors say it is widely practised.
